about_the_game:
About

In Internship, you are one of many unpaid interns trapped aboard a failing corporate spaceship, tasked with building, repairing, and surviving in deep space. Stranded after a catastrophic mission gone wrong, your only hope is to venture into dangerous cave biomes, gather resources, and expand the ship—while juggling absurd corporate demands. As the station grows, so do the challenges, unexpected hazards, and ridiculous intergalactic office politics. With an overbearing AI supervisor, bizarre alien encounters, and a never-ending to-do list, you must prove your worth, climb the corporate ladder, and maybe—just maybe—escape this never-ending internship.

Tiny Interns 

The tiny interns may be small, but they are the backbone of the spaceship colony—underpaid, overworked, and hilariously unqualified for the chaos they face. Assigned to every task imaginable, from building and repairing to resource gathering and survival, these wide-eyed recruits navigate disasters with determination and sheer luck. Whether swinging through zero gravity, barely dodging collapsing caves, or getting tangled in their own ropes, they persist—because quitting isn’t an option in space. As the colony expands, so do their roles, unlocking new skills, equipment, and increasingly absurd corporate demands. They may be interns, but they’re humanity’s last hope.


Fans + Community

Thank you for supporting our efforts to build this game. Without you, the project would have died long ago. Your fan art, animations and sculptures motivated us to keep going!

For more LORE

Download the game "No Humanity - The Hardest Game" on your phone to get a taste of what we are cooking :0

short_description: InternShip is a chaotic physics-based space survival game where interns swing, smash, and build their way to survival. Use rope mechanics to collect resources, battle enemies, and expand your space colony. Explore humorous cave biomes and survive absurd corporate tasks in deep space.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese
